# FLX-5050: this process flushes subnormal results to zero

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

KERNEL-SPEC-2 section 5.1: kernel 0.2.0's continuous draws are binary64 arithmetic, and their bits are the same on every machine only when every operation is the IEEE 754 one. A process whose floating-point environment flushes subnormal results to zero, which some compiled libraries switch on while they run (fast-math builds, some audio and machine-learning runtimes), computes other bits. Half of the smallest normal number, computed while the run starts, came out zero here, so the run is refused before it draws anything. Run in a process that has not loaded such a library, or plan the run under kernel 0.1.0, whose continuous draws are decimal.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5050
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
